node.statement: The geometric hypothesis is already contained in node 1 once its class language is read according to def-maincb-partition-state. That definition makes the class family C available only when j~k iff dim S^A_{P_j,P_k}=1 is an equivalence relation; node 1 says that U and V are disjoint nonempty unions sharing no class, so it invokes that class family and therefore entails that ~ is an equivalence relation. Reflexivity then gives j~j for every atomic index j, and the defining biconditional yields dim S^A_{P_j,P_j}=1. Since P_j=w(e_j), these are precisely the one-dimensional atomic images required by lem-maincb-stage3-call-envelope and lem-maincb-cross-datum-bijectivity. The proposed A=M_2(C) oplus M_2(C) counterexample does not satisfy node 1: there dim S^A_{P_j,P_j}=4, so j is not related to itself, ~ is not an equivalence relation, and the class family whose unions U,V are required to be does not exist.
